body.zh-Hant: 邱吉爾是倫道夫·邱吉爾勛爵與其美籍妻子珍妮·傑羅姆之子，就讀哈羅公學與桑赫斯特軍校，短暫而多事的軍旅生涯後，於1900年成為保守黨下議院議員。議會紀錄載明他自1900年10月1日起代表奧爾德姆選區。GOV.UK 說他1904年轉投自由黨，此後十年在自由黨政府中步步高升；諾貝爾基金會的傳記稱他在二十世紀前三十年於自由黨與保守黨政府擔任過許多要職。
body.en: Churchill was the son of Lord Randolph Churchill and his American wife Jennie Jerome, and was educated at Harrow and Sandhurst. After a brief but eventful army career he became a Conservative Member of Parliament in 1900; the parliamentary record shows him sitting for Oldham from 1 October 1900. GOV.UK says he defected to the Liberal Party in 1904 and spent the next decade climbing the ranks of the Liberal government, and the Nobel Foundation biography says he held many high posts in Liberal and Conservative governments in the first three decades of the century.

body.zh-Hant: Hansard 人物頁依序列出他的政府職位：次官（1906–1908）、商務部大臣（1908–1910）、內政大臣（1910–1911）、海軍大臣（1911–1915）。GOV.UK 稱他任海軍大臣時發生加里波利戰役的慘敗，他因此受到嚴厲批評而辭去該職，並前往西線親自作戰。
body.en: Historic Hansard lists his offices in order: Under-Secretary (1906–1908), President of the Board of Trade (1908–1910), Home Secretary (1910–1911) and First Lord of the Admiralty (1911–1915). GOV.UK says that by the time of the disastrous Gallipoli campaign he was First Lord of the Admiralty; heavily criticised, he resigned from the post and travelled to the Western Front to fight himself.

heading.en: Chancellor and the years out of office

body.zh-Hant: GOV.UK 記載他自1924年起出任財政大臣，並以爭議性的決定讓英國重回金本位；議會紀錄載明他自1924年10月29日起代表愛平選區。保守黨1929年大選失利後，他此後約十一年大多不在官位。GOV.UK 又說他獨自堅決反對印度獨立，也警告過對納粹德國的綏靖政策。
body.en: GOV.UK records that he served as Chancellor of the Exchequer from 1924, when he controversially opted for Britain to re-join the Gold Standard; the parliamentary record shows him sitting for Epping from 29 October 1924. After the Tory electoral defeat in 1929 he spent much of the next eleven years out of office. GOV.UK adds that he stood alone in his firm opposition to Indian independence and warned against the appeasement of Nazi Germany.

body.zh-Hant: GOV.UK 說，張伯倫辭職後，邱吉爾被選為繼任首相，領導一個全黨派聯合政府，並另自創國防大臣一職。Hansard 載明他任首相自1940年5月10日至1945年7月25日；諾貝爾基金會傳記也說他以首相兼國防大臣身分任職到1945年。他在1945年大選中敗給工黨領袖艾德禮而下台。
body.en: GOV.UK says that after Chamberlain's resignation Churchill was chosen to succeed him as Prime Minister of an all-party coalition government, and that he also adopted the self-created position of Minister for Defence. Hansard records his premiership from 10 May 1940 to 25 July 1945, and the Nobel Foundation biography says he was Prime Minister and Minister of Defence until 1945. He was defeated in the 1945 general election by the Labour leader Clement Attlee.

body.en: Parliament's record shows him sitting for Woodford from 5 July 1945 until 15 October 1964, and serving a second premiership from 26 October 1951 to 5 April 1955. The Nobel Foundation biography says he resigned in 1955 and remained a Member of Parliament until the general election of 1964, when he did not seek re-election.

body.zh-Hant: 據《牛津英國史指南》，德·瓦萊拉生於紐約，在利默里克郡長大，原本是數學教師。他是復活節起義最後倖存的指揮官；1917年初獲釋後，他領導一個廣泛的新芬黨聯盟。1919年2月他從林肯監獄脫逃，並成為愛爾蘭議會（Dáil）的主席。
body.en: According to The Oxford Companion to British History, de Valera was born in New York, reared in Co. Limerick, and was originally a mathematics teacher. He was the last surviving commandant of the Easter Rising; following his release from internment in early 1917 he led a broad-based Sinn Féin coalition. He escaped from Lincoln gaol in February 1919 and became president of the Dáil.

heading.zh-Hant: 條約之爭與 Fianna Fáil 的成立

body.zh-Hant: 德·瓦萊拉反對英愛條約，提出「對外聯繫」作替代方案，內戰結束後他在共和派中重拾領導，被關押到1924年反而對此有所助益。議會資料顯示他1922至1923年在第三屆議會屬新芬黨，1923至1927年第四屆屬共和黨，1927年第五屆起屬 Fianna Fáil。據該條目，他與新芬黨及愛爾蘭共和軍的議會缺席政策分裂，另組 Fianna Fáil，並於1927年進入議會。
body.en: De Valera opposed the Anglo-Irish treaty and advanced external association as an alternative; he recovered the leadership among republicans after the civil war, helped by being imprisoned until 1924. The Oireachtas record lists him as Sinn Féin in the 3rd Dáil (1922–1923), Republican in the 4th (1923–1927) and Fianna Fáil from the 5th Dáil in 1927. The Companion says he split from Sinn Féin and the IRA and their abstentionist policy and formed Fianna Fáil, entering the Dáil in 1927.

body.zh-Hant: 據《牛津英國史指南》，1932年選舉獲勝後，他推行修改條約的政策，廢除對英王的效忠宣誓，並停止向英國繳付土地年金。議會資料顯示他在第七屆議會（1932–1933）任行政委員會主席並兼外交部長；外交部長一職歷第八至第十二屆議會，最後記載是第十二屆（1944–1948）。
body.en: The Companion says that after winning the 1932 election he followed a treaty reform policy, abolishing the oath of allegiance to the British crown and ceasing payment of land annuities to Britain. The Oireachtas record shows him as President of the Executive Council and Minister for External Affairs in the 7th Dáil (1932–1933), and as Minister for External Affairs across the 8th to 12th Dáil, the last entry being the 12th (1944–1948).

body.zh-Hant: 愛爾蘭憲法於1937年7月1日由人民通過，自1937年12月29日起施行，並把政府首腦稱為 Taoiseach。議會資料顯示他在第九屆議會（1937–1938）任 Taoiseach，此後一直任到第十二屆議會（1944–1948），期間1939至1940年兼任教育部長、1941年兼任地方政府與公共衛生部長。《牛津英國史指南》說1937年憲法體現他社會與文化上的保守，又說他在二戰中奉行得到民意支持的中立政策，儘管英美強烈反對。
body.en: The Constitution was enacted by the people on 1 July 1937 and has been in operation since 29 December 1937; it calls the head of the Government the Taoiseach. The Oireachtas record shows de Valera as Taoiseach in the 9th Dáil (1937–1938) and thereafter through the 12th (1944–1948), also Minister for Education (1939–1940) and for Local Government and Public Health (1941). The Companion says the 1937 constitution epitomized his social and cultural conservatism and that he followed a popular neutrality policy in the Second World War despite intense British and American opposition.

body.zh-Hant: 據《拉丁美洲歷史與文化百科》，烏維科（Jorge Ubico y Castañeda）1878年11月10日生於瓜地馬拉城，在美國的學校受教育，1894年進入瓜地馬拉軍事學院，1897年從軍。他在1906年與薩爾瓦多的邊界戰爭中作戰，二十八歲前已升到上校。
body.en: According to the Encyclopedia of Latin American History and Culture, Jorge Ubico y Castañeda was born on 10 November 1878 in Guatemala City and was educated at schools in the United States before entering the military academy in Guatemala in 1894. He entered the military in 1897, fought in the border war with El Salvador in 1906, and attained the rank of colonel by the age of twenty-eight.

heading.en: State governor and minister of war

body.zh-Hant: 條目稱烏維科曾任兩個州的州長，並從1922年起在總統奧雷利亞納（José María Orellana）手下擔任戰爭部長，直到1926年。
body.en: The entry says Ubico served as governor of two states and, beginning in 1922, as minister of war under President José María Orellana until 1926.

body.zh-Hant: 條目說他在經濟大蕭條的動盪年代以一致選舉出任總統（1931–1944）。他主持高度個人化的政權，其進步黨掌控政府與立法機關，並舉行兩次無對手的公民投票使他連任。1934年的流浪法廢除債務奴役，卻改為對國家的勞動義務；他並興建了全國第一批公路與電報網。他以嚴酷手段維持秩序。Grieb 在1976年的論文中稱他的獨裁持續了十三年。
body.en: The entry says he came to power as president by unanimous election in the turbulent years of the Great Depression (1931–1944). He directed a personalista regime; his Progressive Party controlled the government and the legislature and conducted two plebiscites that reelected him without opposition. The Vagrancy Law of 1934 abolished debt peonage and substituted a labor obligation to the state, and he built the nation's first highway and telegraph networks, while his regime used harsh methods to maintain internal order. In a 1976 article Grieb says his dictatorship lasted thirteen years.

heading.en: The Second World War and the fall

body.zh-Hant: 據美國國務院的外交文書導言，1941年12月珍珠港遭襲時，他對日本、義大利與德國宣戰。他宣布要執政到至少1949年，引來中上階層抗議；1944年7月1日他屈服於壓力，把權力交給龐塞（Federico Ponce Vaides）領導的軍政團，而龐塞只撐了三個月。Grieb 的論文說他突然決定辭職，顯然是在6月30日認定再努力已屬徒勞；大使電報則記載國會於7月4日接受他的辭職並宣布龐塞為臨時總統。1944年10月19日初級軍官政變推翻龐塞，並把烏維科送入流亡。
body.en: The Foreign Relations of the United States introduction says that when Pearl Harbor was attacked in December 1941 he declared war on Japan, Italy and Germany. When he announced he would remain in office until at least 1949, the middle and upper classes protested; on 1 July 1944 he yielded to the pressure and surrendered power to a junta led by General Federico Ponce Vaides, whose rule lasted only three months. Grieb's article says he abruptly decided to resign, having apparently concluded on 30 June that further efforts were futile, and Ambassador Long's report records that on 4 July Congress accepted his resignation and declared Ponce Provisional President. On 19 October 1944 junior officers ousted Ponce, sending Ubico into exile.
